summary_en: Kobe Bussan executed a share repurchase of 13,472,500 shares at ¥2,969 per share for a total of ¥39,999,852,500 via ToSTNeT-3 on September 30, 2026. This represents approximately 6.1% of issued shares excluding treasury stock as of July 31, 2026, within an authorized frame of up to 16 million shares and ¥40 billion through April 30, 2027.
title_en: Notice regarding share repurchase via off-hours trading transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On September 29, 2026, the Kobe Bussan board resolved to execute a specific share repurchase. The company conducted an off-hours trading transaction via ToSTNeT-3 on September 30, 2026, at 08:45 JST, purchasing shares at the closing price of ¥2,969 per share. The company repurchased 13,472,500 shares for a total consideration of approximately ¥40.0 billion.

This execution is part of an authorized repurchase framework approved on the same date, which permits the company to acquire up to 16 million shares for up to ¥40 billion through April 30, 2027, via market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange including off-hours transactions. The 13.47 million shares acquired represent approximately 6.1% of issued shares excluding treasury stock as of July 31, 2026, based on the denominator of 220,851,947 shares disclosed in the authorization announcement.
